date_window.note: Older foundational and official sources deliberately retained outside recent discovery window.

inclusion_criteria: Primary studies or official documentation relevant to practical validation and the fixed project's model/data
English accessible metadata; full text preferred, abstract-only access explicitly labeled
exclusion_criteria: Unrelated biological target/task or more elaborate capability outside this advancement
Preprints and reviews as evidence for newly implemented behavior
Displayed publication dates beyond cutoff without verified earlier publication
review_kind: Bounded rapid evidence review; one reviewer; not a complete systematic review

full_text_attempts.result: Full text available; uncertainty/active learning/results/conclusions inspected.
Abstract only; no full-text method equivalence claimed.

supplementary_searches.query: Direct commits/main, then README.md and LICENSE at pinned revision
supplementary_searches.access: README and license inspected, model code not copied or executed.

supplementary_searches.query: Retained Sarkisyan 2016 DOI 10.1038/nature17995 and TAPE 2019 proceedings
supplementary_searches.access: Prior project primary-source appraisal retained for data and split meaning; not new search yields.

scope: Auditable retrospective protein active-learning evaluation and reproducible saved results
